b'# tiny-downloader

A simple command-line tool for downloading files from URLs.

## Usage

```bash
tinydl [OPTIONS] URL
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `URL` | what to download (required positional argument) |
| `-o, --output FILE` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q, --quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

```bash
# Download to stdout
tinydl https://example.com/file.txt

# Download to a specific file
tinydl -o output.txt https://example.com/file.txt

# Download quietly (no progress output)
tinydl -q https://example.com/file.txt
```
'
